alert.rule_name: Unsigned Module Loaded by WMI Provider Host
alert.description: WmiPrvSE.exe, the WMI provider host, loaded a module that failed signature validation. WmiPrvSE runs as a service identity and is instantiated on demand by remote WMI requests, so an unsigned module loaded into it executes attacker code on the target host under a service account, triggered from another machine.
alert.detection_logic: Sysmon EventID=7 (ImageLoad) WHERE Image ENDSWITH '\WmiPrvSE.exe' AND Signed = 'false' AND ImageLoaded NOT IN (approved_unsigned_provider_allowlist)
